name: 毛绒猫咪头盔套
description:
猫耳毛绒头盔套，圆脸颊，张着嘴的表情。四个颜色各一件，可以选：绿色（薄荷绿）、蓝色（天蓝）、黄色（奶黄）、粉色。

第一张是四色合集，选了颜色会换成那一色的单品图。
descriptionEn:
Plush cat-ear helmet cover with round cheeks and an open-mouth smile. One of each in four colors: green (mint), blue (sky blue), yellow (cream) and pink.

The first photo shows all four colors — pick a color to see that one on its own.

name: 奶黄小羊头盔套
description: 奶黄色卷卷毛绒头盔套，头顶两只黄色小羊角，粉色内耳和腮红，两侧垂着小毛球。
descriptionEn: Curly cream-yellow plush helmet cover with two little yellow sheep horns, pink inner ears and cheeks, and pom-poms hanging at the sides.

name: 暹罗猫头盔套
description: 白色卷卷毛绒头盔套，暹罗猫配色的奶茶色耳朵和脸，画着小胡须，耳边别着一条浅蓝色小鱼。
descriptionEn: Curly white plush helmet cover in Siamese-cat colors — latte-brown ears and face, little whiskers, and a light-blue fish clipped by the ear.

name: 黑猫月亮头盔套
description: 黑色卷卷毛绒头盔套，粉色猫耳，额头一枚黄色弯月亮，黄色眼睛配粉色腮红。
descriptionEn: Curly black plush helmet cover with pink cat ears, a yellow crescent moon on the forehead, yellow eyes and pink cheeks.

name: 小鸡头盔套
description: 奶黄色小鸡毛绒头盔套，头顶一撮红色鸡冠，两只圆圆的小耳朵，钩织的橙色小嘴配粉色腮红。
descriptionEn: Plush cream-yellow chick helmet cover with a red tuft on top, two round little ears, a crocheted orange beak and pink blushing cheeks.

name: 圣诞小鹿头盔套
description:
焦糖色卷毛小鹿，头顶一对棕色鹿角，一边系着红色蝴蝶结，一边点缀红白小绒球，正中一颗圆滚滚的红鼻子。圣诞季上雪场最应景的一顶。

## 适配与穿戴
- 适配 XS 到 XL 的滑雪/单板头盔（头围约 48–65 cm），常见品牌基本都能戴
- 后面有雪镜扣开口；两侧弹力带勾住护耳，后脑抽绳收紧，滑得快也不会掉
- 头盔顶部装了运动相机支架的话戴不了
- 穿戴：松开抽绳，从前往后套上，让雪镜扣从开口露出来，再收紧抽绳调整
- 外层毛绒、内衬柔软，多一层保暖
- 请不要水洗，弄湿或沾雪用纸巾擦干就好
descriptionEn:
A curly caramel-brown reindeer with plush antlers, a red bow on one side, red-and-white pompoms on the other and a round red pom-pom nose. The most festive thing you can wear on the slopes this season.

## Fit & Care
- Fits ski and snowboard helmets from XS to XL (about 48–65 cm / 19–25.6 in), including most popular brands
- A slot in the back leaves room for your goggle clip; elastic side straps hook around the ear pads and a drawstring cinches it snug, so it stays put at speed
- Not compatible with a camera mount on top of the helmet
- To put it on: loosen the drawstring, pull the cover on front to back, line the goggle clip up with the slot, then tighten
- Plush outer with a soft lining for a little extra warmth
- Please don't wash it — if it gets wet or snowy, just pat it dry with a tissue

name: 粉色兜帽垂耳兔头盔套
description: 粉白羊羔绒垂耳兔，粉色兜帽造型，两侧圆圆的粉色耳饰和垂下来的长耳朵，白色小脸配黄色小鼻子。
descriptionEn: A pink-and-white sherpa bunny in a pink hood, with fluffy round ear puffs, long floppy ears and a little yellow nose.

name: 玫红蕾丝猫头盔套
nameEn: Hot Pink Lace Cat Helmet Cover
description: 亮玫红长毛猫咪，黄色毛绒耳朵镶着白色蕾丝边，刺绣的爱心叉叉大眼配小腮红，甜酷风。
descriptionEn: A bright hot-pink faux-fur cat with lace-trimmed yellow ears, embroidered heart-and-X eyes and little blush marks. Sweet with an edge.

name: 紫黑恶魔兔头盔套
nameEn: Purple & Black Devil Bunny Helmet Cover
description: 左黑右紫的撞色长毛兔，两只垂耳也是一黑一紫，头顶一对螺旋小恶魔角，刺绣叉叉眼和露出小尖牙的爱心嘴，酷酷的暗黑可爱风。
descriptionEn: A split purple-and-black shaggy bunny with matching two-tone floppy ears, a pair of spiral devil horns, embroidered X eyes and a heart-shaped grin with a tiny fang. Cute with a dark side.

name: 奶白蝴蝶结小羊头盔套
description: 奶白色卷卷羊羔毛，头顶一个粉色蝴蝶结和两颗粉色小绒球，两侧圆圆的毛球耳朵，刺绣金色眼睛配粉色腮红，温柔又软萌。
descriptionEn: Curly cream-white sherpa lamb with a pink bow and two blush-pink pompoms on top, round fluffy ears, embroidered golden eyes and pink cheeks. Soft and sweet.

name: 黄色笑脸小熊头盔套
description: 亮黄色长毛小熊，圆圆的毛球耳朵，刺绣大眼睛、红鼻子和咧嘴笑，阳光又元气，在雪地里特别显眼。
descriptionEn: A sunny yellow shaggy bear with round pompom ears, big embroidered eyes, a red nose and a wide grin. Impossible to miss on a snowy slope.

name: 粉色星星眼毛球头盔套
description: 粉嫩长毛小圆球，两只圆耳朵，一边别着黄色小星星绒球，星星大眼睛和红腮红都是刺绣的。
descriptionEn: A fluffy pink puff with round ears, a little yellow star pompom on one side, and embroidered starry eyes and rosy cheeks.

name: 蓝色瞌睡小象头盔套
description: 浅蓝色长毛小象，闭着眼睛的睡萌表情，翘起的小鼻子，两只粉色内里的大耳朵垂在两边，头顶一顶黄色小帽。
descriptionEn: A pale-blue fluffy elephant with sleepy closed eyes, a little upturned trunk, big pink-lined ears hanging down each side and a yellow hat on top.

name: 棕色小老鼠头盔套
description: 棕色毛绒小老鼠，两只大耳朵，刺绣的大眼睛和胡须，浅色口鼻配一个机灵的笑。
descriptionEn: A brown plush mouse with big ears, embroidered cartoon eyes and whiskers, and a cheeky smile on a light muzzle.

name: 黄色醒狮头盔套
description:
黄色醒狮毛绒头盔套：额头绣着“王”字，橙色大耳朵上点缀梅花刺绣，金鱼造型的立体鼻子配一双蓝色大眼睛，白色毛绒眉毛和包边。喜庆又有中国风，过年前后上雪场特别应景。

## 做工细节
- 鼻子是单独缝上的立体配件，层次更饱满
- 眼睛、耳朵和鬓毛都是细密刺绣
- 护耳内外撞色，和主体内衬用不同材质
- 后面留有雪镜扣开口，抽绳可以收紧
descriptionEn:
A yellow lion-dance helmet cover with the Chinese character for “king” embroidered on the forehead, big orange ears dotted with plum-blossom embroidery, a 3D goldfish-shaped nose, wide blue eyes, and white plush brows and trim. Festive and full of Chinese New Year spirit.

## Craftsmanship
- The nose is a separate 3D piece for extra depth
- Dense, detailed embroidery on the eyes, ears and whiskers
- Two-tone ear flaps, with a different lining fabric from the body
- Slot in the back for your goggle clip, plus a drawstring to cinch it snug

name: 青绿小龙头盔套
description:
青绿色毛绒小龙：头顶一对黄色立体龙角，两侧是层层叠叠的蓝色鬓毛，蓝色眉毛下一双黄色大眼睛，中间是祥云纹的黄色立体鼻子，底边一圈深灰色毛绒。很有国风神兽的感觉。

## 做工细节
- 鼻子是单独缝上的立体配件
- 眼睛和祥云纹都是细密刺绣
- 鬓毛是多层双面绣拼接，很立体
- 龙角立体有支撑，底座撞色
- 后面留有雪镜扣开口，抽绳可以收紧
descriptionEn:
A teal-green plush dragon with a pair of 3D golden antlers, layered blue manes on both sides, big golden eyes under blue brows, a cloud-patterned 3D nose and dark grey fur trim. A mythical beast for the slopes.

## Craftsmanship
- The nose is a separate 3D piece
- Dense, detailed embroidery on the eyes and cloud patterns
- Layered, double-sided embroidered manes for a full 3D look
- Structured 3D antlers on contrasting bases
- Slot in the back for your goggle clip, plus a drawstring to cinch it snug

name: 紫色繁花头盔套
description:
深紫色毛绒头盔套，正面铺满层层叠叠的淡紫和浅粉色立体花朵，一对大大的浅紫色蝶翼耳朵带银色刺绣，两侧点缀蜜桃色毛球，护耳下挂着盘扣和双色流苏。梦幻又有国风感。

## 做工细节
- 花朵是多层叠搭的立体刺绣，像一整片花丛
- 耳朵内置骨架，可以随意弯折造型
- 盘扣加深浅两色流苏
- 护耳内外同材质撞色，内衬用不同材质
- 后面留有雪镜扣开口，抽绳可以收紧
descriptionEn:
A deep-purple plush helmet cover blanketed in layered lavender and pale-pink 3D flowers, with big lilac butterfly-wing ears trimmed in silver embroidery, peach pompoms on the sides, and Chinese knot buttons with two-tone tassels hanging from the ear flaps. Dreamy with a traditional twist.

## Craftsmanship
- Layered 3D embroidered flowers that read like a whole flower bed
- Wired ears you can bend into shape
- Chinese knot buttons with two-tone tassels
- Two-tone ear flaps in matching fabric, with a separate lining
- Slot in the back for your goggle clip, plus a drawstring to cinch it snug

name: 莓果粉小熊头盔套
description: 莓果粉长毛小熊头盔套，圆圆的耳朵里是黑色绒毛，黑色亮面眼睛和小鼻子，毛茸茸的一大颗，戴上就是行走的玩偶。
descriptionEn: A shaggy berry-pink bear helmet cover with black fluffy inner ears, shiny black eyes and a little black nose. One big fuzzy head that turns you into a walking plush toy.
